fragments.translation: Words to be said by Osiris:
Irethoreru, son of Neherirsen,
born of the lady of the house Tadiusir, justified.
Hail to you, lords of justice, free from evil,

fragments.transliteration: wnnw ꜥnḫ(.w) r nḥḥ ḥntj ḏt
fragments.translation: who will be alive for eternity, lasting forever.
May you reveal me to the land,
for I am an akh spirit in your form,
I am powerful with your magic,
and I am counted among your number.

fragments.transliteration: nḥm=ṯn wj m ꜣd jmj jw n mꜣꜥtjw
fragments.translation: May you rescue me from the agression that is on the island of the righteous.
May you give me my mouth
that I may speak with it.

fragments.transliteration: jm ḏj.tw n=j ꜣwt-ꜥ n m-bꜣḥ=ṯn
fragments.translation: Let gifts be given to me in your presence

fragments.transliteration: ḥr ntt tw=j r{ṯ}ḫ.kw r ṯn
fragments.translation: because I know you,

fragments.transliteration: rḫ.kw rn n nṯr pf ꜥꜣ
fragments.translation: and I know the name of that great god
to whose nose you give sustenance,
whose name is Tekem.

fragments.transliteration: jw=f w(bꜣ)=f ꜣḫt jꜣbtt nt pt
fragments.translation: He opens up the eastern horizon of the sky,

fragments.transliteration: jw=f {jw=f} wbꜣ=f r ꜣḫt jmntt nt pt
fragments.translation: and he opens up the western horizon of the sky.
My leaving is the leaving that he does,
and my preservation is his preservation, and vice versa.
I will not be driven out of the Milky Way.
The evildoers will have no power over me.

fragments.transliteration: jw=j n šnꜥ=ṯn wj ḥr sbꜣw=ṯn
fragments.translation: You will not bar me at your gates,
nor seal your doors to me,

fragments.transliteration: t=j m P ḥnqt=j m Dp
fragments.translation: for my bread is in Pe, and my beer is in Dep.
O, join the arms in the temple
to (my) father Atum for me.
He has established a house for me in [???],

fragments.transliteration: jt bdt jm=f n rḫ ṯnw nb
fragments.translation: where there is barley and emmer, of an unknowable amount,

fragments.transliteration: jr n=j ḥb jm=f jn sꜣ=j n ḏt=j
fragments.translation: and where celebrations are held for me by my son of my body.

fragments.transliteration: ḏj=ṯn n=j prt-ḫrw t ḥnqt kꜣw ꜣpdw
fragments.translation: May you give to me a mortuary offering of bread, beer, oxen and fowl,

fragments.transliteration: ḫt nb nfr wꜥb bnr ꜥnḫ nṯr jm
fragments.translation: and all good, pure and sweet things on which a god lives.
I persist in eternity
in any form that I desire.

fragments.transliteration: ḫd=j m sḫt-jꜣrw ḫnt=j m sḫt-ḥtp
fragments.translation: I sail north to the field of rushes and I sail south to the field of offering.
[???] this Ruti.
Revered of Osiris, Irethoreru,
(your) mother Nut spreads (herself) over you
in her name of She Who Equips the Sky,

fragments.transliteration: ḏj wnn=k m nṯr n ḫft r=k
fragments.translation: who lets you be a god without enemies
(in) her name of goddess.
You are the greatest of her children, and Geb is satisfied.
She loves you
and he protects you.
Thoth lets what is against him cease.
May you go out and go in, every day forever,
while your face is content.

fragments.transliteration: n rw=k ḥr ꜥꜣwj nw dwꜣt
fragments.translation: You will not be turned away from the doors of the underworld.
May you enter the chapel every day.
Revered of Osiris,
Irethoreru, son of Neherirsen,
born of the lady of the house Tadiusir, justified.
[???] the Two Truths.
